text: Hello, boys and girls, welcome back to our English class.In today's class, we will learn to write a checklist.Before we start, please make sure that your textbook, notebook, worksheet and pens are right at your hand.请准备好你的课本、笔记本、学习单和笔。Are you ready?Okay, let's start.Suppose your mother is a business woman.She's going on a business trip to Los Angeles, USA.It means your mother will work in Los Angeles for some days.So there must be a lot of things to take.But it will take her a long time to pack the suitcase.And she may not remember to take everything she needs.Could you help her?Do you remember how Mr.Wang helped Mrs.Wang and grandma to check the things at the airport?Yes, with a checklist.They used the checklist to make sure everything was ready.Please read after recording.Checklist.Again, checklist.Good.So maybe to help mother, we should also make a helpful checklist for her business trip.Please think it over.What should we do first?Yes, we'd better know about the weather there first.Then we can choose the things to take for mother.Here is the weather report of Los Angeles in March.It says sometimes it will be raining and the lowest temperature will be 1 degree centigrade.It will be very cold outside.So what does your mother need to take?Let's think about it for one minute and write down the things on your worksheet.Now let's start.The weather report of Los Angeles in March.Time's up.Let's share our ideas.Some of you think mother should take a heavy coat because the temperature is really low.It's very sweet of you.Some think a thick scarf is a good choice to keep warm.Gloves like this are also necessary for such cold days.Great!Others think an umbrella will be quite useful because it will probably rain in Los Angeles.In fact, mother may need some other things for different needs.Do you remember why mother will take this trip?Yes, for business.So she should take some useful things for her work.First, let's look at mother's timetable during her trip.And then we can decide what she needs to take.She will arrive on March the 17th and come back on March the 23rd.During the week, she will visit her company and have a meeting to attend.So think it over.What does mother need to take for her business?Please go.Well, you're so smart.Let's share our ideas together.Some students think a notebook can help mother take down something important.And mother should also take some pens to write with.Maybe a camera is a good choice because mother can use it to take photos when she visits the company.I hear someone says an iPad.Yes, it's also very useful.Maybe some of you have other great ideas.Now it's time for you to write a checklist for mother.To make the checklist clear, we could put different things into different groups.The left group is for mother's daily needs, for example, a coat.The other group is for mother's business, for example, a notebook.Now let's write a checklist on the worksheet within three minutes.Please write as many things as possible in each group.Let's start.Alright, I think you have finished your work.Kitty and Tom can't wait to show us their work.Let's have a look.Which one do you like better?Kitty has put the things into two groups.But is there any problem with her checklist?Maybe Kitty should put pen into the right group and put scarf into the left one.Now the checklist is clearer.Thank you for your help.Now let's take a look at Tom's checklist.What do you think of his work?Yes, I agree with you.I think Tom has done an excellent job, because he has added some other things in each group.For example, when he thinks about Mother's daily needs, he thinks about her.Tom also thinks maybe Mother needs a hat to keep herself warm.And maybe she needs some shoes to change as well.Let's see things for business.Tom has written down a mobile phone, a map and name cards.They are all very helpful.Tom did a great job.I believe you have also written a wonderful checklist.Now with your help, I think your mother will finish packing her suitcase soon.But before the trip, there are still some other things she needs to do.For example, take the passport.What else does she need to do?Let's take a look at Tom's work.Now let's share our ideas.Yes, take the plane ticket.Get some US dollars from the bank.Some of you think if Mother calls a taxi to get to the airport, it will be more convenient.Good idea.And also, write down the address of the hotel.It's necessary.Now please help Mother write a checklist of the things she needs to do on your worksheet.Well, it's time for us to share our work.Let's take a look at Peter's work.He writes more necessary things for Mother.For example,Check the flight information, like the flight number, the departure time so she won't miss the plane.Take some favorite books so she can have fun when she's waiting for the plane.Good job, Peter.I think all of you have tried your best to be helpful.Now it's time for you to write a checklist for yourself.Suppose you will go on a study trip to Los Angeles next week.You need to write a checklist to help yourself get well prepared for the trip.What should be put in the checklist?Yes, you're right.First, we should list the things for our daily needs.Second, we should list the things for our study.Last, we should list the things we need to do.You will have three minutes to work out your checklist.Ready?There are three groups of things in his checklist.That's really good.It's easier to check different things quickly.Oh, we find Danny wants to take chess with him.Maybe he can make more new friends by playing chess in Los Angeles.And he will also take several things for his study.They are quite necessary.Let's move on to the things he needs to do.Look, Danny thinks he needs to send an email to the school in Los Angeles and write down its address before his trip.Of course, packing the suitcase properly is also very important.I think Danny's checklist is really very helpful.Do you agree?Today, we have learned how to write checklists for different needs.And you all did a very good job.Here's today's homework.You can find it on your homework sheet.Class is over.See you next time.Thank you for watching.
